game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Ritual Pool, a still ritual pool: the tomb cartographer must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Backpack Append: Use append and remove to manage the tomb cartographer's backpack list as echo phantoms drop loot.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Ritual Pool: a still ritual pool
core_gameplay_loop: In Ritual Pool, repeat each round: Use append and remove to manage the tomb cartographer's backpack list as echo phantoms drop loot. Each round, echo phantoms strike the glyph door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the bag_space value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the glyph door from echo phantoms in Ritual Pool: keep the bag_space meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 63-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: bag_space drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 63-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 6 (applied tier): Backpack Append
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Backpack Append' (Week 7 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Ritual Pool'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bag_space changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against echo phantoms in Ritual Pool.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 63 seconds while bag_space > 0.
